tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Text and titles, on page, surface, sunken, you, agent, own-message and accent-soft.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quieter text: notes, a line under a name, a step's detail. On page, surface, sunken and agent-tone-soft.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Labels, times, ids beside a name. On page and surface. Also a tier's line.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: between rows, around cards.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Buttons' borders, whose words show them, and decoration such as a canvas's dot grid. Never the only sign of anything.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: A field's edge (input, select, text area, an expression): 3 to 1 on surface, page and sunken, so a person sees where to type.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The page behind the cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the sidebar, controls. Also text on agent-tone, service-tone, bad and text (a hint).

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card, such as a decision's changes; rows and buttons under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: What someone can do: links, the primary button, the current page. On page, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: The primary button under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text on accent and accent-strong: the primary button's label.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: What's chosen: the current page, a pressed toggle, a traced value.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard's ring: 2px solid, 2px off the element. 3 to 1 on surface.

tokens.name: you
tokens.usage: Your own messages in a conversation.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: An agent's messages in a conversation.

tokens.name: own-message
tokens.usage: The product's own word in a conversation, beside the agent's and the person's.

tokens.name: agent-tone
tokens.usage: What sets an agent apart from a person: its square mark, its node, the rung it's on. 3 to 1 on surface, and surface on it.

tokens.name: agent-tone-soft
tokens.usage: Behind an agent's node and the rung of autonomy it's on.

tokens.name: service-tone
tokens.usage: Family addition (proposed): a service identity's mark, such as a7c's skills' and a3t's service accounts'. Neutral, never the agent colour.

tokens.name: service-tone-soft
tokens.usage: Family addition (proposed): behind a service identity's node.

tokens.name: viewfinder
tokens.usage: A camera's view, as when photographing a receipt: its own dark, the same in either theme.

tokens.name: viewfinder-line
tokens.usage: Edges and the status pill on a camera's view.

tokens.name: viewfinder-text
tokens.usage: Text and controls on a camera's view.

tokens.name: viewfinder-mark
tokens.usage: The frame that finds a document on a camera's view: the accent's light step, in either theme.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: A document as photographed, such as a receipt: white in either theme.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: The print on a photographed document.

tokens.name: reads
tokens.usage: What a tool does: reads. On reads-bg, page and surface.

tokens.name: reads-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a reads badge.

tokens.name: writes
tokens.usage: Writes what nobody relies on yet: a draft, a proposal, a working copy. On writes-bg.

tokens.name: writes-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a writes badge.

tokens.name: changes
tokens.usage: Changes a record, or a system others rely on. Coral means this and failure, nothing else. On changes-bg and sunken.

tokens.name: changes-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a changes badge.

tokens.name: outside
tokens.usage: Crosses the organisation's edge: reads content from outside, or sends data out. On outside-bg. Darker than accent in light and lighter in dark, so the two differ for colour-blind readers too.

tokens.name: outside-bg
tokens.usage: Behind an outside badge.

tokens.name: own
tokens.usage: The product's own doing: its checks, its own tools, its signed approvals. On own-bg.

tokens.name: own-bg
tokens.usage: Behind an own badge.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Going well: active, passed, done, deployed. On good-bg.

tokens.name: good-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a good badge; a right grade.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Waiting on someone: a decision, an approval, a grade. On warn-bg.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a warn badge; what to know before deciding.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Failed, refused, denied. On bad-bg; surface on it for the danger button.

tokens.name: bad-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a bad badge; a critical grade.

tokens.name: idle
tokens.usage: Paused, not needed, not started yet. On idle-bg.

tokens.name: idle-bg
tokens.usage: Behind an idle badge, and a badge with no tone.
